intro: The imperfective gerund usually expresses an action simultaneous with that of the main verb: читая, обсуждая, работая.

frases.estudio: Читая статью, я выписывал незнакомые слова.
frases.alumno: While reading the article, I noted down the unfamiliar words.
While they discussed the project, the participants took notes.

piezas.titulo: The imperfective gerund usually expresses an action simultaneous with that of the main verb: читая, обсуждая, работая.
texto: The imperfective gerund usually expresses an action simultaneous with that of the main verb: читая, обсуждая, работая.
The implied subject must be the same in both actions: Сравнивая данные, исследователь сделал вывод.

pregunta.texto: What relation does читая usually express?
